reason: Fitting refolded crop into native full receptor can break bonds at graft boundaries. Pilot protein01 C189-N190=2.38 A and C383-N384=5.33 A; PROPKA warns about failed protonation. No shifts from these failed models were accepted.
corrected_method: PROPKA on intact modeled 194-residue crop plus binder, free binder in identical conformation; full-dimer fit retained for collision checks only.
limitations: Omitted receptor and glycans, and artificial crop termini, can influence pKa.
